notes: DEVELOPMENT BALANCE, revision 3 (2026-10-02). dev-2 numbers unchanged plus goal_xp: flat XP per completed daily goal by slot (doc 24). Small next to activity XP (a 45 min strength session is ~95). Goal XP is untapered and credits the template's attribute at attribute_points_per_xp. Not yet simulated with goals; see docs/21 and docs/24 step 6. daily_quest added the same day (duration 240 min, XP 6/10/16 at 60/30/10).

daily_taper.notes: Per family, per local day. Minutes above full_credit_minutes earn taper_rate; minutes above hard_cap_minutes earn 0. History is still logged.

day_boundary.notes: An event belongs to the local calendar day of its started_at. Sessions crossing midnight are not split in dev-1.

structured_workout.notes: Structured strength sessions are often logged after the fact in under a minute. The user confirms a session length at finish (default_minutes when not logged live); credit is max(duration, valid sets x minutes_per_valid_set), capped, then the daily taper applies.

daily_quest.notes: Doc 24. 4 h (owner, 2026-10-02). Unlocks when every goal of the day is done. XP per return sits around one goal's worth; the reveal and the line are the reward.
